description: OWASP Top 10 Application Security Risks mapped to Legion telemetry

rules.title: Broken Access Control
rules.description: Users acting outside their intended permissions; privilege escalation detected.
rules.remediation: Review and enforce least-privilege. Audit all elevated processes immediately.

rules.title: Injection
rules.description: YARA signatures matched files that may contain injection artifacts or shellcode.
rules.remediation: Investigate YARA-flagged files. Quarantine suspicious binaries. Review input validation.

rules.title: Security Misconfiguration
rules.description: Baseline drift detected: new processes, packages, or remote IPs outside known-good state.
rules.remediation: Review all baseline drifts. Remove unauthorized packages/processes. Harden default config.

rules.title: Vulnerable and Outdated Components
rules.description: OSV.dev vulnerability findings detected in scanned packages.
rules.remediation: Update or replace vulnerable packages. Apply vendor patches. Review transitive dependencies.

rules.title: Identification and Authentication Failures
rules.description: Windows Event ID 4625: failed logon attempts detected in the security log.
rules.remediation: Investigate failed logon sources. Enable account lockout policy. Review MFA coverage.

rules.title: Software and Data Integrity Failures
rules.description: High/critical AI SDK threats detected: malicious packages, vulnerable frameworks, or typosquats.
rules.remediation: Remove or quarantine flagged AI packages. Pin dependencies. Verify package hashes.

rules.title: Server-Side Request Forgery
rules.description: Connections to blacklisted IPs detected, suggesting outbound SSRF or C2 communication.
rules.remediation: Block outbound connections to flagged IPs. Review services making outbound requests. Audit firewall rules.
